subject: R74's CI watch has silently degraded to a guaranteed no-op: SHIP_CI_TIMEOUT=1800s but this repo's CI now runs 30-33min, so EVERY land exits 12 (shipped but unwatched). Second occurrence of the same mechanism (300s->1800s on 2026-08-01)
done_when: a land on current CI concludes inside the ceiling; the ceiling is documented as a give-up threshold set by owner patience, NOT tuned to observed duration

notes.text: measured, not guessed: 139 mutations / 6 shards = 24 on the slowest x ~85s on CI = ~2040s against an 1800s ceiling. Raised to 5400s and reframed as a give-up threshold set by owner patience — the asymmetry is that too-high costs waiting only when CI hangs, too-low costs the guarantee on every ship
